Develops enterprise data models at several levels of detail. Develops and maintains enterprise dimensional data structures. Specifies processes for maintenance of dimensions and sets of dimensions. (50% time)

Directs, initiates and designs data/information management studies. Prepares recommendations for data/information management and/or resource plans having critical, organization-wide and/or institution-wide impact. (15% time)

Regularly leads, directs, analyzes and prepares recommendations for data management information needs across process domains and academic disciplines. Performs analysis, up to and including the most complex and advanced. (15% time)

People Development and Team Leadership: Foster a culture of servant leadership within your team, prioritizing the growth and well-being of your direct reports. Empower your team to make decisions, take ownership of their work, and grow their skills. Act as a coach and mentor, helping your team members overcome obstacles and achieve their professional goals. (10% time)
Designs overall sourcing strategies. Designs and maintains communication across functional areas or disciplinary domains. (5% time)

Agile Leadership: Mentor the Data Science & AI team in an agile development process, guiding daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives along with our scrum master. Manage project backlogs and ensure a steady cadence of product delivery, helping the team prioritize tasks and remove blockers. (5% time)
